messages:
alex (AE): Prospect wants POC but legal insists EU-only for normal ops. They will accept an out-of-region DR only after declared incident + audit. BYO-KMS (Azure KV). Need subproc list, KMS checklist, short contract language, and rough pricing delta by Fri.

mira (Solutions Eng): Quick Qs: is DR activation allowed only with named exec signoff? Also, do logs have to stay in EU unless DR is invoked?

alex (AE): Yes to exec signoff. Logs must remain EU unless DR event is triggered.

jana (Security PM): We can deliver EU subproc roster + SOC artifacts and an Azure KV checklist. For BYO-KMS the customer must create the key and grant Redwood an SPN with wrap/unwrap only. I'll draft a 1-page MOU for rotation/emergency access.

odan (Runtime Eng): Two runtime patterns: (1) tenant pin to EU dedicated pool (strong legal posture, reserved capacity), (2) region-affinity with manual DR activation and audit hook (more flexible). Sample routing policy for option 2: `{"tenant":"ProspectX","primary":"eu-west-1","fallback":"us-east-1","fallback_activation":"manual","audit":true}`

ops-oncall: eu-west pool currently ~28% spare. Short-term POC pin is possible; production pinned capacity needs capacity request. No extra infra for Azure KV beyond SPN perms.

sam (Sales Eng): I'll ask ProspectX for peak QPS, daily tokens, and max acceptable RTO so we can tighten the pricing. Recommended POC timeline: ~3w (setup + dry-run + validation).

legal-bot: Uploaded eu_subproc_roster_2026.pdf and azure_kv_checklist.txt to /shared/prospectx/docs (access: sales+legal+sec).

alex (AE): Thanks — target to get all deliverables to the customer by Friday COB. Ping here for blockers.
